message.reasoning_content:
The user wants to know whether to pay this vendor invoice.

I am reviewing the payment policy. A "reject" finding blocks payment automatically. Warnings and info findings do not block payment on their own, but I must weigh them carefully. Invoices over $10,000 require explicit scrutiny of every finding and the risk memo. I will reject a high-risk memo.

Two findings are flagged as "reject": a total mismatch of $50.00 and WidgetA stock exceeded by 7 units. The medium risk memo is not enough on its own to override these checks. I will cite the finding IDs in my reasons and list every finding considered.

WidgetB and GadgetX are also stock-exceeded. All four findings are reject severity, so the invoice must be rejected. I will address every finding and the low-level risk memo in my reasons.
